snippet.title: The Lacerator | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The Lacerator launches on Steam on October 9th. 

You are Max, the most legendary porn star of the 1980s. After being kidnapped by a crazed killer during a routine shoot, you must find your way out of The Lacerator’s mansion with your life, and ideally your limbs, intact.

The Lacerator is a third-person survival horror game where if you’re not careful, escape might cost you an arm and a leg. Explore a branching storyline with multiple endings, as well as five unique lacerations that will force you to navigate the mansion in different ways. Lost your leg and can’t reach that ladder? Replace it with a chainsaw and kick your way to freedom. 

Store link: https://dreadxp.games/LaceratorYT

Follow the dev: https://x.com/gamesfromabyss

Join the community: https://discord.gg/JTPfXdSFXq
